title: Chapter 1449 - 2: Don'T Go! Absolutely Don'T Go!!!
content:
Chapter 1449 - 2: Don'T Go! Absolutely Don'T Go!!!

Chapter 1449 - 2: Don't Go! Absolutely Don't Go!!!

If you magnified this slender shadow a billion times, you would discover a black dragon towering to the heavens and reaching across the earth, a black dragon comparable to the pinnacle dimensional space of Golden Moon Dimension.

Yet at this moment, in Lin Yuan's palm, this black dragon seemed like an 'eel!

"Dragon Stone Lord?"

The Time-Space Shop Owner gazed blankly at the 'eel' in Lin Yuan's hand.

From Lin Yuan reaching out his right hand to retracting it, only an instant had passed.

As a Legendary Lord with 'Infinite Origin' as the core, the Dragon Stone Lord's strength was nearly at the limit of a second-level lord. Without such strength, it would be impossible to explore the ancient past spacetime.

Approaching the second-level limit of lordship strength, and coupled with contamination from the remnants of the 'Returning Ruins Lord', he seemed mad.

It can be said that even a real second-level limit lord would not want to provoke the Dragon Stone Lord.

Who knows what other means the remnants left by the 'Returning Ruins Lord' might have, relating to an existence at the threshold of a transcendent path like 'Returning Ruins Lord'; which second-level lord dares to be careless?

But now?

As powerful as Dragon Stone Lord, he was actually 'pulled out' by Lin

Yuan so effortlessly in his own lair?

"Legendary, at least the strength of a Legendary Lord?"

The Time-Space Shop Owner looked at Lin Yuan, his mind racing with thoughts.

In the blink of an eye, countless pieces of information flashed through his mind.

Exploring within the Wanwei spacetime.

Possessing means of a Legendary Lord.

Yet not any Legendary Lord he had ever heard of?

Thoughts gathered and merged in the Time-Space Shop Owner's mind, forming a name-

Galaxy.

The mysterious lord who appeared briefly in the Wanwei spacetime, finally taken away by several Legendary Lords in the deepest region?

Lin Yuan gazed at the Dragon Stone Lord in his palm, trying to make him regain consciousness. The simplest method was, of course, to directly suppress him, then Lin Yuan could help him temporarily recover his sanity.

Even just a remnant will left by a terrifying existence like the 'Returning Ruins Lord', no second-level lord would dare to approach, but Lin Yuan is different; his strength and means had already reached the level of a Legendary Lord at the final stage of billions of tribulations.

With the Myriad Realms Gate suppressed in the deepest part of his mind, even if the Returning Ruins Lord resurrected, he couldn't affect Lin Yuan's mental will, let alone just a remnant will.

"The Dragon Stone Lord will probably wake up in a moment."

Lin Yuan glanced at the Time-Space Shop Owner standing beside him and spoke.

"Okay."

The Time-Space Shop Owner jolted awake, then cautiously asked,

"Are you Lord Galaxy?"

Although he speculated that Lin Yuan was the mysterious lord 'Galaxy' in the Wanwei spacetime.

Speculation was ultimately speculation.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Indeed, the mysterious Galaxy...the Time-Space Shop Owner's heart trembled, as a lord with extensive connections, there was no way to keep from him the happenings in the Wanwei spacetime.

And the biggest event this time in the opening of Wanwei spacetime was the mysterious 'Galaxy' lord.

Not only did he show his future self stepping into the realm of legend, he was also personally greeted by the Legendary Lords in the deepest

region of Wanwei spacetime.

Combining various pieces of information, the lords have already

speculated that the future of the Galaxy Lord is likely to be someone

unimaginable.

Otherwise, how could he have been met proactively by the few

deepest Legendary Lords while still not yet a Legendary Lord?

"I didn't expect, the Galaxy Lord whom other lords are extremely curious and in awe of, I had already known?" The Time-Space Shop Owner thought with immense emotion.

During this period, many lords had naturally sought him out for information on the Galaxy Lord, but the Time-Space Shop Owner himself was extremely curious and had no clue.

"Lord Ye Wu..." the Time-Space Shop Owner suddenly thought of the

Lord of Ye Wu.

Involuntarily feeling sympathetic.

If Lord Ye Wu had accepted Lin Yuan back then, wouldn't he have established a connection with the mysterious Galaxy Lord?

That is a great opportunity that many second-level extreme lords desire but cannot obtain.

In the end, not only did Lord Ye Wu fail to grasp this opportunity. He also left a bad impression on Lin Yuan.

Soon.

Dozens of breaths later.

The struggling Dragon Stone Lord in Lin Yuan's palm gradually calmed

down.

"I am the Dragon Stone..."

The Dragon Stone Lord's eyes regained clarity and then fell into even

greater shock.

"Where is this?"

Looking up, five gigantic pillars that seemed endless connected the heavens and the earth, a vast oppressive force filled the surroundings, and the Dragon Stone Lord felt he couldn't move at all.

The next moment.

The world changed.

The Dragon Stone Lord appeared in the outside world.

He saw a young man and a twelve-eyed beast.

"Who are you?"

The Dragon Stone Lord recognized the twelve-eyed beast, but the

young man was utterly unfamiliar.

Yet all the pressure around stemmed from the young man. "Dragon Stone, this is Lord Galaxy, you are conscious thanks to Lord Galaxy's intervention."

The Time-Space Shopkeeper immediately reminded him.

"Lord Galaxy?"

The Dragon Stone Forest Master had never heard of this title, but the

oppressive force that filled the heavens and earth was indisputable, and he immediately bowed towards Lin Yuan: "Dragon Stone greets

Lord Galaxy."

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded and looked at the Dragon Stone Lord, saying: "I am

here to make a transaction with you, to borrow the Golden Moon Dimension for a period."

"If there's anything you want, feel free to say it."

Lin Yuan said with a smile. "Borrow the Golden Moon Dimension?"

The Dragon Stone Lord glanced at the Golden Moon Dimension

behind him, then at the Time-Space Shopkeeper, and immediately said: "Dragon Stone is willing to offer the Golden Moon Dimension to

Lord Galaxy."

"And all my possessions, totaling seven billion two hundred million pounds of Time Sand."

The Dragon Stone Lord said respectfully.

"Offer the Golden Moon Dimension to me?" Lin Yuan looked at the

Dragon Stone Lord with interest.

Offering the Golden Moon Dimension would be akin to completely giving this top-notch dimensional space to Lin Yuan. This was far more costly than just borrowing it for a time.

Moreover, the Dragon Stone Lord was also handing over all his possessions, over seven billion pounds of Time Sand.

"What do you want?"

Lin Yuan asked.

"I only ask for Lord Galaxy to resolve the 'Returning Ruins Lord'

residue for me." The Dragon Stone Lord said in a low voice. "Resolve the 'Returning Ruins Lord' residue?" Lin Yuan thought for a

moment and said: "I can't guarantee it, but even if I can't completely resolve it, I can suppress part of it, extending the time you remain

conscious."

Based on the previous interaction with the 'Returning Ruins Lord' residue, Lin Yuan was confident he could handle it, as it was just a

residue and separated by unknown time and space.

"No matter the outcome, I accept it."

The Dragon Stone Lord immediately turned to the Time-Space Shopkeeper: "Time-Space, transfer all the Time Sand I left in your

store to Lord Galaxy."

"No problem."

The Time-Space Shopkeeper nodded.

The Time-Space Shop not only handled purchases and sales but also

served as a 'bank,' where many Time Lives deposited their Time Sand. Because the Time-Space Shopkeeper had such a reputable name, Time Lives trusted him greatly.

"Then I will begin."

Lin Yuan said no more, his gaze falling on the Dragon Stone Lord.

Buzz- The Dragon Stone Lord immediately felt his mental will fall, he didn't resist, instead letting himself drift off into sleep.

"Lord of Returning Ruins..."

Lin Yuan simultaneously activated the forces of Tai Yi, Tai Chu, and Tai Shi, three of the "Innate Five Great," beginning to expel the residue pollution deep in the Dragon Stone Lord's body, soul, and mind.

"Truly befitting a lord near the end of the path to transcendence." Lin Yuan marveled in his heart, though he wasn't giving his all, he

wasn't far off, but in expelling the 'Returning Ruins Lord' residue, he still hadn't reached an overwhelming suppression. However, it was only a matter of time before expelling the 'Returning

Ruins Lord' residue.

Several days later.

Amid the clash of forces from Tai Yi, Tai Chu, and Tai Shi of the "Innate Five Great," the residue pollution deep within the Dragon Stone Lord's body, soul, and mind was instantly driven to a certain

place.

These residue pollutions converged, suddenly forming a blurry figure. Originally filled with madness and frenzy, the residue pollution rapidly calmed upon merging into this blurry figure.

"I am Returning Ruins, not knowing if you come from the past or the

future." The blurry figure spoke, "but if you are on the path of 'infinite tribulation,' after surviving the third billionth tribulation, among the final three thousand tribulations bestowed by the Supreme Rule Dao, one tribulation sends you to a certain time and space, to prevent... ascending the new path of transcendence...

At this moment, the tone of the blurry figure suddenly filled with unwillingness and regret:

"Don't go! Absolutely don't go!!!"
